description: Create a project (a group of tasks, usually one per repo). Optional: any tool that takes project creates it on first use. A project with this name (any case) comes back unchanged, and the reply says if your description or color wasn't applied. Says whether it was created, restored or already existed, plus its id. Fails on an invalid name or at the project ceiling.

color.description: Hex color for the board, e.g. "#2f6fdb" (default: picked from the name)

name.description: Project name, e.g. the repo folder ("api-server")

name: taskhold_create_project
title: Create a project
